scenes.heading: Why search is slow in a list
scenes.narration: Searching a plain list takes time, because you may check every item one by one.

scenes.heading: Binary search tree
scenes.narration: A binary search tree keeps smaller values on the left and bigger values on the right.

scenes.heading: Insert: add a diff line
scenes.narration: Insert goes left or right until it finds an empty spot. Here is the change we make.

scenes.heading: Cost of a lookup
scenes.narration: Each step throws away half the tree, so a balanced tree needs about log n steps.
